Identifier $F18Ch - ModeSelector

Description
This identifier writes the ModeSelector

Availability
Supported in the following diagnostic sessions:
- extendedDiagnosticSession

Security Level:
		L1

Request Message:
Byte 1		$2E = Request Service Id "WriteDataByIdentifier"
Byte 2-3	$F18C = ModeSelector

Positive Response Message:
Byte 1		$6E = Response Service Id "WriteDataByIdentifier"
Byte 2-3	$F18C = ModeSelector
Byte 4		Data Record

Data Type:		enum
Storage Position:	EEPROM
Size:			1 bytes
R/W State:		W
NVM Item:		NVM_ID_DCOM_ModeSelector
Value Range:		Enum: 0x00, 0x01, 0x02

================================================================================

Identifier $F1A1h - CalibrationConstant

Description
This identifier writes the CalibrationConstant

Availability
Supported in the following diagnostic sessions:
- extendedDiagnosticSession

Security Level:
		L1

Request Message:
Byte 1		$2E = Request Service Id "WriteDataByIdentifier"
Byte 2-3	$F1A1 = CalibrationConstant

Positive Response Message:
Byte 1		$6E = Response Service Id "WriteDataByIdentifier"
Byte 2-3	$F1A1 = CalibrationConstant
Byte 4		Data Record

Data Type:		Unsigned
Storage Position:	EEPROM
Size:			1 bytes
R/W State:		W
NVM Item:		NVM_ID_DCOM_CalibrationConstant
Value Range:		5 ~ 5

================================================================================
